notes.title: The Cooking Game is now free to play!
notes.content:
Dear Steam users,

We have decided to make The Cooking Game a "Free to Play" game. 🍔🍟 🍕
It's been years since we released The Cooking Game.
However it's a shame that not everyone has the chance to experience this wonderful game.
Hence, from today onwards, we have made available a new version of The Cooking Game, for everyone to start cooking! 🍳
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26620342/d94e3b622c6164e47c1c90c22f9a0afd3fec6752.png[/img]

The newest update from today contains these following changes:
- Removed Chef-on-the-go game mode
- Updated Kitchen layout
- Simplified recipes for each restaurant
- Simplified game play for easier players' progress
- Critical bugs/crashes eliminated
- Achievements bugs eliminated
- "Flight of your life" airplane bug fixed
-  Added micro transactions/IAP

[b]Special Gift for Past Purchasers🎁[/b]
For players who have supported us by purchasing this game in the past,  we have made available a special gift for you! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26620342/a349084240b28b85a77e6d12c3fe9b216238284c.png[/img]

Upon updating to the latest version (from today), you will see the above bonus gift popup.
This bonus gift contains in-game currencies of  100,000 coins and 750 diamonds worth $49.99.
Make sure you tap on "[b]CLAIM[/b]" button to add them to your inventories.

Note: 
To be able to claim the free gift above, you must have previous version of The Cooking Game installed in your Steam library. 

Last but not least, we want to thank everyone for your amazing support of the past few years.
We will continue to improve and add more features to the game.
Wish everyone a happy holiday and Merry Christmas! 🎅🏻 🍾

notes.title: Update March 7/2017: Achievement Bug Fixes + New Features + Steam Cloud
notes.content:
You talked, we listened.

We have just made a big list of changes to existing game.

Here are what were changed in this latest update:

[b] 1. Achievement Bugs Fixed. We have fixed the following achievements: [/b]
"Master kebab man- complete all missions in R2 with 3 stars"
"Jackpot- Win 2000 coins in casino in one spin"
"Taking no breaks- Played 1 hour straight"
"Restaurant Monopoly- Upgraded 5 restaurants completely"
"Master Kebab man- Compete all missions in Arab restaurant with 3 stars"
"Better luck next time- spin coin machine at casino 8 times in a row without winning"

[b] 2. All restaurants are now UNLOCKED from the start. [/b]
No more unlocking restaurants with coins/diamonds and chef level.
* Chef-on-the-go however are locked until players have finished certain missions of each particular restaurant. 
The reason is in "Chef on the go" game play, you are required to cook and serve any of the dishes available in that particular restaurant.
Hence there is a need for player to finish certain missions in the relevant restaurant to go through the learning process.

 [b] 3. Each restaurant now has its own label of "difficulty".  [/b]
We suggest players to start with restaurant with the lowest difficulty score and slowly work his way up.

[b] 4. "Reset progress" button is now added. [/b]
Warning: Using this button will erase all your progress you have previously saved.

[b] 5. 10 FREE diamonds is added to the players balance from the start. [/b]

[b] 6. Steam Cloud is now available. [/b]
Now you can sync your progress and play across different PCs.
